sections.text_helper: Section 11.1 "GPIO introduction" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 339.
sections.section_content:
Each general-purpose I/O port has four 32-bit configuration registers (GPIOx_MODER,
GPIOx_OTYPER, GPIOx_OSPEEDR, and GPIOx_PUPDR), two 32-bit data registers
(GPIOx_IDR and GPIOx_ODR), a 16-bit reset register (GPIOx_BRR), and a 32-bit set/reset
register (GPIOx_BSRR).
In addition, all GPIOs have a 32-bit locking register (GPIOx_LCKR) and two 32-bit alternate
function selection registers (GPIOx_AFRH and GPIOx_AFRL).
